formative_worksheets.title: The Symmetry and Area Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming symmetry counting and area conservation before maps.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can count symmetry lines and conserve area.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can count symmetry lines and conserve area.
header.character_watermark: Symmy with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: 3 shapes (square, triangle, F-letter) with answer lines.

image_placeholders.description: 3 shapes for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Square, equilateral triangle, letter F. Each ~1.5in. Below each: 'Lines of symmetry: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_SYM at Prompt 1: keywords name the activity.

prompts.prompt: Same 6 tiles in 2 shapes — which has more area?

image_placeholders.description: Two tile arrangements for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Same 6 tiles in: 2x3 rectangle (compact) + L-shape (spread). Below: 'Which has more area?' with options A / B / SAME.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_AREA at Prompt 2: keywords name the visual elements.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 2 formative check.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.
